name: criteria-hxr-v3a
definedBefore: any HXR backtest or result (hxr-prereg-3a). As criteria-hxr-v3 plus: two benchmarks (the fully invested hold and the day-one positions held), the development pick rule left to the owner (amendment 3b), fresh entries reported apart.
judgedOn: final period, basket A (ten stocks), the frozen candidate against both benchmarks from the same US$15,000; only after the validation gate passes

outcomes.FAIL: G1 is met and at least one of G2-G6 fails
outcomes.PASS: every criterion passes. This means eligible for the owner's review only; it is never permission to trade and never connects anything

selection.pickRuleRecorded: amendment 3b, 2026-10-23, before any run: ending_value (most profit), chosen by the owner; return_to_drawdown is not used

return_to_drawdown.metric: annualised return / largest decline from a previous peak

selection.stopIfNone: no qualifying candidate beats both benchmarks: HXR has no candidate worth validating; validation and final are never used
selection.oneWinner: only the single winner goes to validation, then to final; a validation failure stops HXR; no runner-up is ever tried

criteria.name: Enough evidence
criteria.rule: at least 500 sessions, at least 20 completed exit-and-buy-back round trips, and a decline of at least 20% from a previous peak in the fully invested hold

criteria.name: Smaller worst decline
criteria.rule: HXR largest decline <= 0.75 x each benchmark's (against both benchmarks)

criteria.name: Better return per unit of decline
criteria.rule: HXR annualised return / largest decline >= 1.10 x each benchmark's (against both benchmarks)

criteria.name: Limited return given up
criteria.rule: HXR annualised return >= each benchmark's minus 5 percentage points (against both benchmarks)

criteria.name: Robust to costs and delay
criteria.rule: G2 and G3 still pass against both benchmarks with spread and slippage doubled, and separately with fills one session later

criteria.name: Not one stock
criteria.rule: G3 passes against both benchmarks in at least 9 of the 10 leave-one-stock-out runs

prospective.name: Enough time and decisions
prospective.rule: at least 6 months and at least 10 exit or buy-back decisions; otherwise insufficient evidence

prospective.name: Operationally clean
prospective.rule: at least 95% of sessions processed on time; no duplicate orders; every fill has a bar

prospective.name: Fill realism
prospective.rule: median absolute difference between assumed and realistic fills <= 25 bps

prospective.name: Consistent with history
prospective.rule: reported against the historical result; never called proof of the news-informed strategy

reportedNotGated: missed rebounds and losses after buying back
position sizes and the binding cap
signals lapsed for budget or pause
open risk and tech/AI exposure over time
average invested fraction and return on average invested capital
fresh entries (at or above the previous sale price, or never held) apart from buy-backs

V1.name: Enough round trips in validation
V1.rule: at least 10 completed exit-and-buy-back round trips (fresh entries do not count); otherwise insufficient evidence and HXR stops before the final period

V2.name: Still better than holding per unit of decline
V2.rule: annualised return / largest decline >= 1.10 x each benchmark's (the fully invested hold and the day-one positions held) in the validation period; otherwise HXR stops before the final period (reported as did not validate)
